d:
The Mavericks defeated the Warriors, 116-94 tonight in Dallas. Cooper Flagg contributed a team-high 33 points to go with 9 assists 5 rebounds and 4 steals, with P.J. Washington of the Mavericks adding an additional 21 points (7-10 FG, 5-7 3P) in the game. Will Richard finished with a team-high 20 points along with 4 steals for the Warriors in the losing effort. The Mavericks improve their record to 8-7 with the win, while the Warriors fall to 8-7 for the season.
